objective: Re-evaluate the old multi-image static-cache guard after all inference was moved onto one dedicated thread in round 95.

hypothesis.old_failure: A multi-image static-cache request compiled and executed on a Flask worker whose CUDA-graph thread-local state differed from startup prewarm.
hypothesis.new_condition: Round 95 now runs prewarm and all generation on one dedicated inference thread.
hypothesis.candidate: Keep the configured static KV cache for six-image Agent requests instead of applying multi_image_static_cache_guard.

setup_failures_preserved.cause: The isolated candidate directory did not include the production helper module path.
setup_failures_preserved.fix: Set PYTHONPATH to the unchanged production VLM directory.

setup_failures_preserved.error: Selected GPU has existing compute work; no processes were stopped
setup_failures_preserved.cause: The prior owned VLM process had exited, but its CUDA context had not yet disappeared from the driver process list.
setup_failures_preserved.fix: Wait for the selected GPU UUID to have no compute process before starting the candidate.

calls.geometry_difference: Both fill_gap polygons changed from three-corner closed shapes to full rectangles, changing six Y coordinates and potentially the final raster intersection.

paired_replay.interpretation: Steady-state static requests were about 8.5 to 8.9 percent faster, but the first new six-image static shape incurred a 32.4 percent penalty and made the three-call total slower. One call also changed fill geometry, so the candidate fails both aggregate latency and exact-geometry gates.

decision.reason: A larger startup prewarm cannot repair the observed geometry difference and would add shape-specific startup cost.

boundary: This is a three-call execution-engine A/B, not a model-accuracy or generalization evaluation. The candidate was rejected and the formal runtime was restored before this evidence was written.
